newsitem.title: MEXICO: Azcarraga Jean heir to Televisa chair - report.
newsitem.headline: Azcarraga Jean heir to Televisa chair - report.

text.p: Emilio Azcarraga Jean, the son of the late head of Mexican media firm Televisa SA eventually will take over as chairman of the board, a newspaper report said on Tuesday.

Azcarraga Jean, president and chief executive officer, will replace current chairman Guillermo Canedo White within the next few months or year, Reforma newspaper quoted unnamed high-ranking company officials as saying.
Emilio Azcarraga Milmo, the power at Televisa until his death two weeks ago, appointed Canedo as temporary chairman only until Azcarraga Jean, 29, felt ready to take over, Reforma said.
Televisa has an annual shareholders' meeting set for Wednesday and is expected to announce an executive committee that will help make decisions at the group.
